# Recommendation Engine: Worked Examples

*Generated by `src/recommender.py` from the cleaned data. Scores: 0.40 × rating + 0.25 × popularity + 0.20 × budget + 0.15 × cuisine, each 0–1.*

Hard filters: city, locality (optional), minimum rating, delivery. Budget (local currency) and cuisine are scored, not filtered, so a close alternative can still appear with a lower score.
